topic: Bile acids' crucial role in fat absorption and detox
caption: Did you know bile acids play a crucial role in fat absorption and detox? 🌟 Bile acids are produced by the liver and stored in the gallbladder. They help break down fats into smaller particles, making them easier to absorb. 💡 But that's not all - bile acids also help remove toxins from the body. 🌿 Save this so you don't lose it.
